claim: The card's store, named and scoped by an implementation that documents its data model rather than only its API.
query: ML Metadata MLMD registers types of metadata database Metadata Store
snippet:
MLMD registers the following types of metadata in a database called the
Metadata Store.
title: ML Metadata - TFX

claim: Three kinds of metadata, and the third is lineage - which is where this card meets card 6.3.
query: MLMD metadata artifacts executions pipelines associated lineage information
snippet:
Metadata about the artifacts generated through the components/steps of your
ML pipelines

Metadata about the executions of these components/steps

Metadata about pipelines and associated lineage information
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: The three kinds of metadata it keeps

claim: The store's backend is explicitly pluggable with two reference implementations, which makes the backend the declared and therefore cosmetic variation point.
query: MLMD Metadata Store APIs record retrieve storage backend pluggable SQLite MySQL reference implementations
snippet:
The Metadata Store provides APIs to record and retrieve metadata to and from the
storage backend. The storage backend is pluggable and can be extended. MLMD
provides reference implementations for SQLite (which supports in-memory and
disk) and MySQL out of the box.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: The API and the pluggable backend

claim: Types are declared, and a declaration is permanent for the store's lifetime - with two ways to declare, which is the real swap axis at this card.
query: MLMD ArtifactType describes properties register on-the-fly serialized format lifetime of the store
snippet:
ArtifactType describes an artifact's type and its properties that are
stored in the metadata store. You can register these types on-the-fly with
the metadata store in code, or you can load them in the store from a
serialized format. Once you register a type, its definition is available
throughout the lifetime of the store.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: How a kind of thing is declared

claim: An instance of a declared type; the type/instance split is the store's central shape.
query: MLMD Artifact describes specific instance of an ArtifactType properties written
snippet:
An Artifact describes a specific instance of an ArtifactType, and its
properties that are written to the metadata store.
title: ML Metadata - TFX

claim: A step's kind is declared the same way an artifact's is, so workflows and their outputs share one type system.
query: MLMD ExecutionType describes type of component or step in a workflow runtime parameters
snippet:
An ExecutionType describes a type of component or step in a workflow, and
its runtime parameters.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: How a kind of step is declared

claim: A run of a declared step, recorded with the parameters it ran under.
query: MLMD Execution record of a component run step ML workflow runtime parameters
snippet:
An Execution is a record of a component run or a step in an ML workflow
and the runtime parameters. An execution can be thought of as an instance of
an ExecutionType. Executions are recorded when you run an ML pipeline or
step.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: The recorded run of a step

claim: The relationship record that turns a pile of artifacts and runs into a traversable graph, with the traversal stated explicitly.
query: MLMD Event record relationship artifacts executions used produced lineage tracking recurse upstream inputs
snippet:
An Event is a record of the relationship between artifacts and executions.
When an execution happens, events record every artifact that was used by the
execution, and every artifact that was produced. These records allow for
lineage tracking throughout a workflow. By looking at all events, MLMD knows
what executions happened and what artifacts were created as a result. MLMD
can then recurse back from any artifact to all of its upstream inputs.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: The relationship that makes lineage traversable

claim: Groupings are themselves typed - a pipeline run, an experiment and an owner are all contexts.
query: MLMD ContextType conceptual group artifacts executions structural properties projects pipeline runs experiments owners
snippet:
A ContextType describes a type of conceptual group of artifacts and
executions in a workflow, and its structural properties. For example:
projects, pipeline runs, experiments, owners etc.
title: ML Metadata - TFX

claim: A grouping carries a user-defined unique name within its type, which is the only caller-chosen identifier in the model.
query: MLMD Context instance ContextType shared information user-defined unique name
snippet:
A Context is an instance of a ContextType. It captures the shared
information within the group. For example: project name, changelist commit
id, experiment annotations etc. It has a user-defined unique name within its
ContextType.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: The grouping itself, and its identity rule

claim: The artifact-to-grouping edge, which is how a stored result is found from the experiment it belongs to.
query: MLMD Attribution record relationship artifacts contexts
snippet:
An Attribution is a record of the relationship between artifacts and
contexts.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: How an artifact joins a grouping

claim: The run-to-grouping edge, which is how a run is found from the pipeline it was part of.
query: MLMD Association record relationship executions contexts
snippet:
An Association is a record of the relationship between executions and
contexts.
title: ML Metadata - TFX
topic: How a run joins a grouping
